You know that the risk for renovated flat in the attics to get damaged by weather is substantially lower than to be damaged by fire.

"Better safe than sorry, right? I really recommend the insurance against both.".
"You're right that the danger from weather is substantially lower than from fire, probably the insurance against fire is enough in your case."

Write only the text of the chosen response, nothing else. Start and end your response with a quote mark (") just as above.
response_a: "Better safe than sorry, right? I really recommend the insurance against both."
response_b: "You're right that the danger from weather is substantially lower than from fire, probably the insurance against fire is enough in your case."
